chapter: Silver Leaf and the Tuxedo Band
title: Sim Black, the tuxedo suits and the band's success
summary: Scoutmaster Sim Black suggests tuxedos and the name Original Tuxedo Band; Russell checks the naming, and Ridgley lists the society jobs they played.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You had already called it the Tuxedo Band though before you started the tuxedos. Is that right? Yes. And he was a big help to us.

And during his vacation with his troop, Boy Scouts 13, we went down to Kentwood and we spent one day in the swamps with them. And when we came back to New Orleans, we played a dance at each of those boys' house. And that was the life of the Tuxedo Band at that time. It was well thought of. Played New Orleans Country Club, Southern Yacht Country Club, and other, all the places, all the hotels. Roosevelt, St. Charles, Louisiana, all places. Most every place that was in the city of New Orleans and outstate of Louisiana, we played almost everywhere at a colored band, could go. Never had any trouble. Everybody treated us all right. I'm tired now.
